name: block_allocator_memory
replacement: use enable_block_allocator to turn the block allocator on or off

name: custom_profiling_settings
replacement: choose the profiler's metrics with CALL enable_profiling([...])

name: deprecated_using_key_syntax
replacement: the UNION syntax it enabled for USING KEY CTEs is no longer supported

name: enable_http_logging
replacement: log HTTP requests with CALL enable_logging('HTTP')

name: http_logging_output
replacement: HTTP requests are logged by the logger, configured with logging_storage
